subject: Service availability advisory — targeted EU/APAC availability and client-directed failover
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
To: acme-support@acme.com, sara@fintechco.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.o@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Service availability advisory — targeted EU/APAC availability and client-directed failover

Hi team,

I wanted to quickly notify you that we are seeing a targeted availability degradation in a subset of EU-West and APAC edge availability zones that may intermittently affect inference latency and request failures for customers routing to those edge clusters. Our detection surfaced elevated error rates from the EU-West-2 and APAC-SG edge pools at ~07:45 UTC.

What we're doing (short):
- Engaged infra and cloud partners to isolate a networking config drift in peering that is causing uneven health checks to some edge nodes.
- Applying prioritized rollback to the affected peering rules; we expect partial mitigation within the hour.
- Activating cross-region fallback routes for eligible flows to preserve latency SLOs.

What you can do right now (recommended, optional):
1) If you can accept slightly higher egress latency but want reliability, configure your Redwood client to prefer regional fallback (US) for inference by adding the request header x-redwood-region-preference: us. Example: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "x-redwood-region-preference: us" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
2) If you use our SDKs, call RedwoodClient.set_region_hint('us') for the duration.

We've attached a brief step-by-step doc (customer-traffic-steer-steps.pdf) with sample curl/SDK snippets and a small checklist for smoke-testing after switching.

Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2028-07-22-eu-apac-edge-degradation (we will update there).

I will follow up with a more complete timeline and mitigation confirmation. If you'd like Redwood to make the change for you, reply here and we will coordinate a one-time traffic steering change for your account.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll keep this focused and short.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: customer-traffic-steer-steps.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Acme Support <acme-support@acme.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service availability advisory — targeted EU/APAC availability and client-directed failover

Thanks Monica — Sara (FinTechCo) and I are seeing increased 5xx from the EU edge. A couple quick Qs:
- If we set x-redwood-region-preference: us, will our requests be billed the same and will tokens be preserved?
- Can Redwood temporarily pin our account to US region for the next 24 hours?

Can someone make the change if we confirm? We need to get our prod traffic stable for the next business day.

— Tom (on behalf of Acme)
From: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
To: acme-support@acme.com, sara@fintechco.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.o@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service availability advisory — targeted EU/APAC availability and client-directed failover

Hi Tom — quick answers and an offer to apply the change for you: 

1) Billing/token behavior: region preference is a routing hint only. Token accounting (per-token billing) is unchanged. Model outputs and token consumption remain consistent; only the network path and hosting region changes.

2) Temporary pin: yes — we can apply an account-level region pin to direct all inference to US hosts while we complete remediation. We'll require a confirmation email with a PTD window (start time and desired duration).

If you'd like Redwood to do this for you, reply with "Please pin Acme to US for 24h starting 2028-07-22T10:00:00Z" and we'll schedule the change. Once applied we'll share a validation checklist and a timeboxed rollback plan.

Internal note: @vanessa.o and @marissa.c — can we provision a 1-click pin for Acme and FinTechCo and queue it for 10:00Z if they confirm? See attachment (redwood_eu_apac_az_incident_log_snippet.txt) for the error signature we observed.

Thanks,
Monica

On 2028-07-22 08:12, Monica Patel wrote: > [original message omitted for thread brevity]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.o@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service availability advisory — targeted EU/APAC availability and client-directed failover

Monica — provisioning the pin is a one-way ops action (we can rollback). I'll prepare an apply/verify checklist and a short maintenance window announcement for the account. Plan:
- 09:50Z: stage routing rule to account sandbox (dry-run)
- 10:00Z: enable pin for Acme & FinTechCo (24h)
- 10:05Z: smoke-test sample request, verify 200s and token parity
- 10:20Z: monitor 10m and confirm to customers

I'll coordinate with NetOps to ensure no additional peering changes during this window.

On operations: attach the verification artifact to HS-23456 in HubSpot once complete.

— Vanessa
From: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
To: acme-support@acme.com, sara@fintechco.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.o@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Update: Account-level pin applied for Acme and FinTechCo — validation and post-incident follow-up

Hi Tom / Sara,

Update: we applied the account-level region pin to route your inference traffic to US hosts at 10:00Z as requested. Initial validation results:
- Sample generation requests returned 200/OK across 10 smoke tests; latency increased by ~60–120ms (median ~85ms).
- Token accounting matched expected values; no token duplication observed.

Please run a few production-analog requests against your integration and confirm success. Suggested quick test (prod key safe):
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "x-redwood-region-preference: us" -d '{"input":"health-check"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

Next steps:
- Our infra team will continue with the peering rollback and validations; we'll post a full incident timeline and RCA within 72 hours.
- We will proactively apply a credit to your account equivalent to one day of baseline usage as a goodwill gesture while the incident is being resolved.

If you'd like Redwood to revert before the 24h window, reply with "Revert pin now" and we'll roll back within 10 minutes.

Thanks for the quick coordination — please confirm the smoke test results when convenient.

Best,
Monica

Attachments: redwood_eu_apac_az_incident_log_snippet.txt (log snippet); customer-traffic-steer-steps.pdf (how-to)
From: Acme Support <acme-support@acme.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-23T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Update: Account-level pin applied for Acme and FinTechCo — validation and post-incident follow-up

Monica — confirmed. Our health checks passed after the pin; throughput looks stable and user-facing errors dropped to baseline. Appreciate the proactive credit and the clear rollback path.

Please include our account in the postmortem distribution and any long-term mitigations for peering fragility.

— Tom
